articles.summary: On October 29, 2026, Ivanti updated its security advisory for Ivanti Connect Secure (ICS) to include two additional vulnerabilities and released fixes for both. Ivanti rates CVE-2026-111357, a missing authentication for critical function vulnerability (CWE-306), with a CVSSv3.1 score of 8.8; it allows a local authenticated attacker to escalate privileges. CVE-2026-118527, classified as generation of predictable numbers or identifiers (CWE-340), has an Ivanti-assigned CVSSv3.0 score of 4.3 and, according to CISA's KEV entry, allows a remote authenticated attacker to upload attacker-controlled content to a known location on disk.
articles.title: Additional Ivanti Connect Secure zero-days exploited in the wild (CVE-2026-111357, CVE-2026-118527)

articles.summary: On November 6, 2026, the Apache Software Foundation disclosed CVE-2026-90436, a critical unsafe reflection vulnerability (CWE-470) in Axis 1.x that allows for unauthenticated remote code execution (RCE). Apache Axis is a Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP) implementation used for the creation of Java Web services. CISA has assigned CVE-2026-90436 a CVSS score of 9.8 Critical.
articles.title: Rapid7 Detected Exploitation of CVE-2026-90436 against Atlassian Confluence Data Center, N-able N-central also Exploited

articles.summary: As part of our research into Zimbra Collaboration Suite, Rapid7 reported five findings in ONLYOFFICE Docs. An attacker with view-only access to a document can chain vulnerabilities in ONLYOFFICE Docs to execute arbitrary operating system commands as root inside the official DocumentServer container.
articles.title: From view-only access to container root: five vulnerabilities in ONLYOFFICE Docs (FIXED)

articles.summary: On November 17, 2026, public reports described CVE-2026-114938 as a memory corruption vulnerability in Java 17 and above that could allow a remote attacker to execute code without authentication. The reported severity is Critical, with a CVSSv4 score of 9.2. These CVE-specific details remain preliminary, pending confirmation in Oracle or OpenJDK advisories; Rapid7 is actively monitoring the situation and will update this blog as new information arrives.
articles.title: CVE-2026-114938: Reported Critical Pre-authentication Remote Code Execution in Java 17
